title: Firmware vulnerabilities
description: Unsigned or vulnerable firmware enables persistence and device takeover.
mitigations: Secure Boot with verified boot chain | Signed firmware and strict versioning | Secure OTA updates with rollback protection | Regular vulnerability scanning and SBOM management

title: Physical tampering
description: Adversaries can access debug ports, extract secrets, or alter hardware.
mitigations: Tamper-evident and tamper-resistant enclosures | Disable/lock debug interfaces in production | Secure elements/TPM for key storage | Tamper sensors with alerting and zeroization

title: Privacy breaches
description: Sensitive data exposure or over-collection enabling re-identification.
mitigations: Data minimization and purpose limitation | Field-level encryption and tokenization | Access controls with least privilege | Anonymization/pseudonymization where possible

title: Data integrity compromise
description: Unauthorized or undetected modification of data in transit or at rest.
mitigations: Cryptographic integrity (HMAC, signatures) | Immutable/append-only logs and versioned storage | Checksums and validation on ingestion | Strong change control and auditing

title: Eavesdropping
description: Unencrypted or poorly configured links expose data in transit.
mitigations: TLS 1.2+ with modern ciphers | Mutual TLS for device authentication | WPA3 or cellular with SIM-based auth | Rotate keys; avoid static shared secrets

title: Man-in-the-middle
description: Traffic interception or impersonation between nodes.
mitigations: Certificate pinning and strict hostname verification | Mutual TLS and hardware-backed keys | Use message authentication (HMAC/MAC) for app-layer integrity | Replay protection (nonces, timestamps)
